items.explanation: The model says the plugin fetches data over plain http. Anyone on the same network could read or change the data on the way.
items.claim: Fetches updates over http://, not https://.
items.fix: Use https://updates.example-cdn.test/latest.json (and fail if the certificate is rejected).

items.explanation: The model says a secret is stored in the plugin. Here the token is read from an environment variable at run time, so no secret is stored in the code.
